bagger_288.prompt:
Use case: style-transfer. Asset type: a finished vertical 2:3 Minecraft map voting poster. Change the supplied Bagger 288 poster into a MODERN ARCHITECTURAL BLUEPRINT / ENGINEERING DRAWING, BLACK INK ON CLEAN WHITE PAPER. Use the second supplied original webpage screenshot to preserve the exact recognizable Minecraft excavator architecture, enormous bucket wheel, long cantilever trusses, central mast, stairs, furnished multi-storey body, tracked base, cables and gantries. Render the machine in intricate precise thin black technical linework, crisp drafting detail and subtle line-weight hierarchy, with a large central axonometric engineering view and smaller side elevation or mechanical detail insets, restrained dimension arrows and fine drafting guides (no arbitrary unreadable text). Pure black and white, abundant white paper, modern editorial grid, professionally typeset. No ocean, sky, sunset, orange, texture grunge, cream, photoreal shading, sepia, or dark background. Oversized clear title exactly "BAGGER 288" in bold modern technical sans serif placed in a wide BOTTOM-LEFT title block, about 85% of poster width. Small title-block credits exactly "BUILD BY KAIZEN87" and "BACKSTABBED++". Keep machinery dominant and intricate. Preserve attribution. Flat artwork, no mockup, no tilted paper.
Final correction: Keep this black-ink-on-white blueprint composition, its intricate excavator linework, all inset panels, the large bottom title and creator/footer credits. REMOVE every numeric dimension label and measurement unit everywhere (including 142 m, 347 m, 164 m, 44 m, 8 m, 17 m, 46 m, 58 m); preserve the fine dimension arrows and guide lines as unlabeled drafting marks. This is illustrative voting art, so it must not claim inaccurate measured sizes. The ONLY number anywhere must be 288 in the main title BAGGER 288. Keep paper white and linework sharp. Do not change the layout or add new wording.
